content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a great week. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to request a minor adjustment before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause stating "(c) US$100,000 upon on or before March 28, 2014.", the payment is currently scheduled 46 days after the effective date, which delays receipt beyond 30 days. I propose we update this to: "(c) US$100,000 within thirty (30) days of the Effective Date.". Please let me know if this adjustment is acceptable. Best regards,
